# LoungeOS

> LoungeOS is point of sale (POS) and business management software for every kind of business that sells: restaurants, bars, lounges, cafés, nightclubs, hotels, retail shops, supermarkets and more. It is made by Sigalix (https://sigalix.com) and built in Cameroon. It runs in the web app at https://app.loungeos.app and as Windows, Mac and Android apps, with one LoungeOS account everywhere. The Windows and Mac apps keep selling without internet and sync when the connection comes back.

Key facts:
- Version 2.0.0. English and French interface.
- Where it runs: the web app in any modern browser (https://app.loungeos.app); Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit); Mac (Apple Silicon and Intel); Android 6.0 or later. Downloads: https://loungeos.app/download/. Phones and tablets on the same Wi-Fi can use a Windows or Mac till through their browser. The web app and the Android app need internet.
- Account: one LoungeOS account per person, with email and password or Continue with Google. A setup wizard asks for the business type, name, logo, currency, taxes, payment methods and opening hours, and suggests categories to tick. Desktop apps: install, open and sign in; there are no keys or codes. The owner invites staff by email; staff can also use a quick PIN on a shared till. Roles and permissions per staff member.
- Modules: POS for touch and mouse on any screen size, tables and orders, kitchen and bar screens, payment methods each business creates (cash, MTN Mobile Money, Orange Money, card, bank transfer and others), receipts on 58 mm and 80 mm thermal printers or as PDF, inventory with stock movements and low-stock alerts, suppliers, expenses with your own categories, accounting (chart of accounts, journal), reports, staff roles and an activity log, a cloud copy of all data with daily full backups.
- Offline: a Windows or Mac till keeps selling without internet and syncs automatically when it is back online. After 7 days without syncing it becomes read-only until it reconnects, with a warning during the last 2 days. Read-only means past orders, reports, printing and exports still work, but no new sales or edits. When a subscription ends, LoungeOS becomes read-only until it is renewed. Nothing is ever deleted.
- Pricing: every plan starts with a 14-day free trial with Business features and no payment up front. Starter US$10/month (6,000 FCFA): 2 users, 2 devices, POS, inventory, receipts, daily reports. Business US$25/month (15,000 FCFA): 5 users, 5 devices, adds expenses, accounting, shifts and cash control (coming soon), weekly and monthly reports, email alerts (coming soon). Pro US$50/month (30,000 FCFA): unlimited users, 10+ devices, priority support, advanced admin; several branches and payroll are coming soon. Paying yearly gives 2 months free: US$100, US$250 or US$500 a year (60,000, 150,000 or 300,000 FCFA). Visitors in Cameroon see FCFA; everyone else sees US$. Payment by Mobile Money (MTN, Orange), card or PayPal at https://account.loungeos.app, charged in FCFA.
- Not included today: integrated card processing, delivery-platform integrations, hotel PMS folio posting, e-invoicing/fiscal device connections.
- Contact: info@sigalix.com (inquiries), billing@sigalix.com (billing), support@loungeos.app, +237 679 690 703.

## Features

- [POS Features: Tables, KDS, Inventory, Accounting](https://loungeos.app/features/): All LoungeOS features: POS with tables and barcodes, kitchen and bar screens, inventory, staff roles, mobile money, customer tabs, expenses and accounting.
- [Restaurant & Bar Inventory Management Software](https://loungeos.app/features/inventory-management/): Track drinks, ingredients, packaging and shop stock: barcodes, stock levels, low-stock alerts, suppliers, waste logging and CSV import. Every plan.
- [Kitchen Display System (KDS) for Restaurants & Bars](https://loungeos.app/features/kitchen-display-system/): Replace paper tickets with kitchen and bar screens. Food goes to the kitchen, drinks to the bar, with alerts when orders are ready. Works offline.
- [Restaurant Theft Prevention & POS Audit Log](https://loungeos.app/features/loss-prevention/): Stop voids, fake cancellations and cash leaks with staff roles, manager approval for refunds and price changes, cancel reasons and an activity log.
- [POS With Mobile Money: MTN MoMo & Orange Money](https://loungeos.app/features/mobile-money-pos/): Create your own payment methods: MTN Mobile Money, Orange Money, cash, card and more. Record transaction references, split bills and reconcile at closing.
- [Offline POS System: Keep Selling Without Internet](https://loungeos.app/features/offline-pos/): The LoungeOS Windows and Mac apps keep selling without internet: orders, kitchen screens, payments and receipts work on your Wi-Fi and sync later.
- [Restaurant Accounting Software: P&L & Balance Sheet](https://loungeos.app/features/restaurant-accounting/): Record expenses in your own categories, turn sales and stock purchases into double-entry journals, and get a P&L, balance sheet and cash flow.
- [Restaurant Table & Floor Management Software](https://loungeos.app/features/table-management/): Live table status, floors and VIP areas, split bills by item or share, move orders between tables. Keeps the floor organised, online or offline.

## Solutions by venue

- [Bar POS System With Stock Control & Bar Display](https://loungeos.app/bar-pos/): A fast bar POS that tracks every bottle and crate, sends drinks to a bar screen, controls free drinks and discounts, and sells offline on Windows and Mac.
- [Café, Snack Bar & Fast-Food POS System](https://loungeos.app/cafe-pos/): A simple POS for cafés, snack bars and fast food: quick counter orders, packaging stock and mobile money on one laptop or tablet. Sells offline.
- [Hotel Restaurant & Bar POS (F&B Outlets)](https://loungeos.app/hotel-pos/): One POS for your hotel restaurant, bar, pool bar and terrace: kitchen and bar screens, stock control, F&B accounting and offline selling.
- [Lounge POS & Lounge Management Software](https://loungeos.app/lounge-pos/): Lounge management software for VIP areas, bottle sales and events: POS, bar screen, stock and audit log, selling offline on Windows and Mac.
- [Nightclub POS System for High-Volume Drink Service](https://loungeos.app/nightclub-pos/): A nightclub POS for fast drink orders, VIP tables, bottle service and strict cash control. Keeps selling offline on Windows and Mac, over your own Wi-Fi.
- [Restaurant POS System That Works Offline](https://loungeos.app/restaurant-pos/): Offline restaurant POS with table orders, kitchen display, inventory, staff permissions and accounting on your own devices. 14-day free trial.

- [Cloud vs Offline (Local) POS: Which Is Right for Your Restaurant?](https://loungeos.app/blog/cloud-vs-offline-pos/): Cloud POS or local, offline-first POS? Compare how they handle outages, data ownership, cost, security, updates and remote access, with a simple decision guide.

- [POS Permissions for Restaurants: Voids, Discounts & Staff Roles](https://loungeos.app/blog/pos-user-permissions-voids-discounts/): How to set POS user permissions in a restaurant or bar: roles, who can void or discount, approvals, reason codes and the reports to review weekly.

- [Restaurant Employee Theft: 12 Common Schemes & How to Stop Them](https://loungeos.app/blog/restaurant-employee-theft-prevention/): How restaurant and bar staff steal (voids, under-ringing, fake comps, sweethearting, fake mobile money) and the controls that stop each scheme.
- [Restaurant Inventory Management: A Step-by-Step System That Works](https://loungeos.app/blog/restaurant-inventory-management-guide/): Set up restaurant inventory management in 8 steps: item list, units, par levels, receiving, FIFO, waste logging, counts and variance, with examples.
- [15 Restaurant KPIs Every Owner Should Track (With Formulas)](https://loungeos.app/blog/restaurant-kpis-metrics/): The 15 restaurant and bar KPIs that matter: sales, average check, table turnover, food and pour cost, prime cost, labour, voids, discounts and inventory.
- [Restaurant POS Hardware Guide: PC, Tablets, Printer, Wi-Fi, UPS](https://loungeos.app/blog/restaurant-pos-hardware-guide/): What hardware does a restaurant POS need? Host computer specs, tablets, thermal printers, Wi-Fi routers, kitchen screens and UPS sizing, with budget setups.
- [Restaurant Table Management: Floor Plans, Sections & Table Turns](https://loungeos.app/blog/restaurant-table-management/): How to manage restaurant tables: floor plans, waiter sections, table status, turn times, reservations, splitting and merging bills, and key metrics.
- [How to Run a Restaurant During Power Cuts & Internet Outages](https://loungeos.app/blog/run-a-restaurant-during-power-and-internet-outages/): A checklist for keeping a restaurant, bar or lounge running through power cuts and internet outages: backup power, POS, payments, kitchen and cold chain.
